[[File:PiratesMuonGold-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An outpost in the Pirate's Gold region of space.]]
'''Pirate's Gold''', also known as the '''Muon Gold''', was a region of space in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66846&resource=features|text=Star Chart: Tatoo System}}</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the area was inhabited by a band of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] known as the [[Commerce Raiders|Bestine Pirates]]. The pirates named the region after their favorite [[Spice/Legends|spice]]: the [[Muon Gold]]. Despite their consumption of spice, the pirates still piloted their ships with accuracy and lethality, making the Pirate's Gold was one of the most dangerous part of the system.<ref name="SWG:PMG">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space_poi|Pirate's (Muon) Gold|Tatoo system}}</ref>
